questions.question: Who attacked the Philistine garrison with only his armor-bearer?
What rash oath did Saul make that almost cost Jonathan his life?
options: That anyone who ate before evening would be cursed
That no one would speak until the battle ended
That the first man to flee from the fight would be put to death
That the army would fast for seven full days
questions.answer: That anyone who ate before evening would be cursed

questions.question: Jonathan ate honey, not knowing about Saul's oath.
_____ and his armor-bearer attacked the Philistines, trusting the LORD to save by many or few.
Jonathan ate some _____ from the forest, unaware of his father's oath.
